propositions: A peer confirmation store must be created to record evidence of managed link creation, capturing link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source, indexed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation).
The write seam must be injected at the link-phase success point (set_relationship return) via an optional link_confirm callback that is exception-safe and never fails an already-landed outbound link.
Outbound target keys must be reverse-mapped to local ids via binding_store, and unbound targets must skip recording without error.
The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to survive git snapshots and prevent silent drops on confirmation-only changes.

Load must fail-open (corrupt or absent store yields empty without raising), and link_id extraction from set_relationship's return value must handle both missing id and non-mapping returns as non-failures.
